description.value:
Cast 1 day of downtime

Frequency once per week

Requirement The target is willing.

Cost 4 Vitae

Permanent is a word for people who have not seen your table.

Remove one permanent physical affliction from the target: a Runaway Mutation, a Scar, a lost limb (regrown), a permanent drained or enfeebled condition, or comparable lasting bodily harm. A mutation’s Tithe goes with it, and so does its Gift.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Specifically, removing a Runaway Mutation/Scar/Tithe/Gift are all homebrew constructs with nothing to remove.
